source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-5

procedures.title: Heater hoses: routing and replacement
steps: If a hose will not come off the core pipe easily, cut the hose just ahead of the core pipe.
Slit the piece left on the pipe lengthwise, then peel it off.
notes: The core is easily damaged at the seams where the pipes attach if the pipes are forced.
